heading: INT. ARCHIVE VAULT - DEEP-SPACE LIBRARY SHIP - CYCLE UNKNOWN

units.text: INT. ARCHIVE VAULT - DEEP-SPACE LIBRARY SHIP - CYCLE UNKNOWN
A cathedral of data.
Tall cylinders of blue light line the walls, each humming faintly.
The floor is polished obsidian, reflecting everything twice.
A single thread of cold air moves through the nave.
ARCHIVIST LENKA ORLOVA, 60s, in a gray tabard, walks the central aisle with a slate.
She touches each cylinder as she passes, the way a priest touches pews.
ASSISTANT KEZIAH BRANDT, 20s, follows two steps behind with an armload of sleeves.
Her eyes keep drifting upward to the vaulted ceiling.
At the far end, a stool, a lamp, and a figure bent over a console: TECHNICIAN OBADIAH MWANGI, 40s, unshaven, his cuffs stained.
Beside him, a patched service robot, UNIT SEVEN, stands at ease, one optic lens cracked.
It tilts toward the women when they approach.
CAPTAIN ISOLDE VANTERPOOL, 50s, enters from a side door in full dress uniform, boots clicking on the obsidian.
She does not look at anyone.
Captain. You are late for the reading.
units.name: LENKA

units.text: I was delayed by the bridge.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: The bridge is always delayed.
units.name: LENKA

units.text: Shall I start it?
units.name: OBADIAH

units.text: Yes.
units.name: LENKA

units.text: He presses a key.
The cylinders brighten, one by one, until the whole vault glows.
A low chord rises from the floor, like an organ in another room.
Playing record eleven. Origin: Earth. Date: unknown.
units.name: UNIT SEVEN

units.text: Everyone turns to the wall.
Light pools and spills into the shape of a tree, its roots stretching, its branches full of leaves.
Nobody speaks.
Keziah's lips part.
It is much larger than I remembered.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: You have never seen it.
units.name: LENKA

units.text: I remembered it anyway.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Obadiah rises from his stool.
He crosses the vault slowly, hands in his pockets.
He stops beside Isolde and looks up at the tree, then at her profile.
She feels it.
She does not turn.
Lenka clears her throat.
Keziah drops one of the sleeves.
It clatters on the obsidian.
The sound echoes, long, long.
Record eleven is incomplete. Would you like to hear the missing portion?
units.name: UNIT SEVEN

units.text: No.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Yes.
units.name: LENKA

units.text: They look at each other.
A beat.
The tree flickers.
Isolde unclasps her jacket collar with a short, tight motion.
Play it.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: The robot raises its cracked lens.
The chord darkens.
The tree burns, quietly, to ash.
